services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Comprehensive room repaints, feature walls, and full interior refreshes. We prepare surfaces properly, use quality paints, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Weatherproof exterior repaints including woodwork, fascias, and cladding. Our work protects your property and enhances kerb appeal for years to come.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Office refurbishment, retail redecorations, and workplace updates completed to schedule with minimal disruption to your business.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging, feature wall creation, and pattern matching. We handle tricky corners and textured surfaces with precision.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Expert preparation, undercoating, and top coats for doors, skirting boards, window frames, and bespoke joinery. Durable, hard-wearing finishes.

services.title: Prep & Protection Services
services.desc: Thorough surface preparation including sanding, filling, and priming. We protect your furniture and floors during every job — no shortcuts.

about_pullquote: We do the job once, properly, so you don't have to call again.
about_para_1: M&T Painting and Decorating was founded on the principle that good painters are hard to find. With over 12 years' experience serving Leicester and the surrounding areas, we've built a reputation for reliable, thorough work and honest pricing. Our team takes pride in every project, from small interior redecorations to large commercial contracts.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we turn up on time, communicate clearly, and deliver a finish that lasts. We don't rush the preparation or cut corners on paint quality — that's why our work stands the test of time and why so many Leicester homeowners and businesses recommend us to their friends and neighbours.
reviews_heading: What Leicester Homeowners Say About M&T

reviews.text: Mark did our whole house interior a few months back — living room, three bedrooms, kitchen. Really meticulous with the prep work, didn't leave a mess, and the finish is immaculate. Prices were fair and he stuck to the schedule. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: We needed the exterior repainting after some weather damage. M&T came out, gave us a proper quote within a day, and the work was done in less than a week. New paint looks brilliant and they cleaned everything up after. Very professional outfit.
reviews.author: Helen T.

reviews.text: Had them decorate our office reception area. No faffing about, arrived when they said, and the transformation was exactly what we'd discussed. Minimal disruption to the team. Would recommend to any business in Leicester.
reviews.author: James M.
